GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Ridden Along Went Forward Settled Down 1 Lengths Clear Hard Ridden x 600m, Collared Straightening Up Weakened to the line - # led the winner

Jumped well and Went Forward to lead on fence by two-thirds of a length settling down, Held Together in front & led by a half length turning, joined Straightening Up , raced head'n'head until taking a slender margin at the 50m, just lasted to the line # just lasted to win
Jumped awkwardly then Went Forward to 2 Lengths Lead on fence, Held Together in front & led 1.5 Lengths turning, Headed 250m and weakened from there # weak once headed
Jumped Fast Straight To The Front Settled Down 2 Lengths Clear with 1st following extended lead to 5 Lengths x 600m, flat @ 200m Collared x 50m, # unable to pinch it

Jumped Ok Went Forward Settled Down 2 Lengths Clear extended margin to 7 Lengths x 1000m, then only 1 Lengths Clear x 600 and Soon After Straightening Up Couldn'T Go On - assing the 800m made respiratory noises and from that point weakened noticeably - # resp noises
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr explained gelding over raced early and then failed to settle. Passing the 800m made respiratory noises and from that point weakened noticeably. A post race vet exam revealed no abs. Vet cert including scope required prior to accepting for a future jump out, trial or race.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Ridden Along Went Forward Settled Down 1 Lengths Clear own terms field spread out, Ridden Along Turning for home lay out Under Pressure Soon After Straightening Up only Collared x 50m, # gave good sight

Jumped ok looking for a spot settled third fence 3 Lengths (800m), Ridden Along approaching Turn , not running on early Straight , held Ground at best # fitter for further

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped well went looking for the lead & got it settling down 2 Lengths Clear (1400m), ran them along & margin cut Turn , beat rival off into the Straight & booted Clear again, kept on going # backed/all the way!
Jumped Ok Not Bustled but Went Forward Settled Down 1 Lengths Clear Set  Good Pace To The Turn Hard Ridden Collared x 300m, and Couldn'T Go On but # Went Too Hard
